servicesProducts.servicesList:
1. Software POS point of sales. Cloud Services Monitor and manage unlimited sales, employees, inventory, reports and multiple stores.

2. Work Offline 
Keep recording sales and run operation even when offline and sync database to cloud when online.

3. Advanced Inventory Management
Create purchase orders, goods receive notes, estimate, inventory history report and manage stock. 

4. Employee Management
Create users, commision staff, manage access right, login alerts and sales by employee. 

5. Financial Management
Automation sales summary with an unrestricted date filter to accurately calculate net profit before accounting for the cost of goods sold, operational expenditures, and overhead.


6.Marketing Management
Collect database information to identify the most popular and best-selling items, and analyze customer behavior to enhance upselling strategies and utilize redemption points to foster loyalty.
